Forecasters, Traders Bet on Larger Fed Rate Hikes

Forecasters and traders are betting that the U.S. Federal Reserve may need to implement larger interest rate hikes. Some anticipate two hikes, while others predict a half-point increase in December. This outlook suggests a more aggressive monetary policy stance from the Fed.
